services.name: Parasail
services.desc: Join us for our safe, exhilarating family adventure, flying up to 600 or 800 feet. About Three Generations is Just Routine Almost every day we see the kids, mom and dad, and a set of grandparents board a KrantzKraft parasailing boat to launch a family adventure. It is safe, fun, and EXHILARATING! We require that you weigh at least 60 pounds and be prepared to smile so much your face hurts. We’ve Been Taking Families Parasailing Safely Since 1986 Every launch and retrieval takes place from inside a boat custom designed for this activity. Aloft, the views of Oahu are spectacular. Your photos will be stunning! Higher, Longer and More Awesome Flights are Available Wear a swimsuit!

services.name: Jet Ski
services.desc: Looking for jet ski rentals in Oahu? H2O Sports Hawaii offers high-speed Yamaha WaveRunner rides on a designated ocean course in Honolulu, just minutes from Waikiki. Due to Hawaii state regulations, jet skiing takes place within a marked ocean course area, providing a safe and exciting experience with views of Diamond Head. Jet Ski rides take place in a designated area in Honolulu, O’ahu per Hawaii State

services.name: Bumper Tube
services.desc: You are on your tummy, your face just inches from the water and the wake of a jet ski. About Bumper Tube: Want Wetter? Try Submerging! You are on your tummy, your face just inches from the water and the wake of a jet ski. Sound wet enough? Whether you are in Maunalua Bay or the Hawai‘i Kai Lagoon, our advice is simple: Don’t let go! The result will be momentary, total immersion in Hawaiian waters! This Can Be a Family Experience A lot of kids challenge their elders to join in. This is one of the reasons we want even would-be observers to wear a bathing suit. Want Something Slightly Dryer? Banana boats are a bit more tame. You get to stay in a seated position, assuming you master hanging on!

services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Banana boats cause smiling. We believe this to be scientific fact, though we can’t prove it. About Mount Up, Hang On, Get Wet! Let’s just say that no one at H2O Sports Hawaii can recall anyone ever frowning while getting drenched on a banana boat ride. Is it even legal to have so many laughs? It sure is in Hawai’i! Youngsters, Oldsters, and Everyone in the Middle There are two basic requirements: The ability to stay seated and hang on. Everyone wears a life vest. The water is shallow, and you can get quite damp. An Even Wetter Experience If the banana boat experience seems too tame, try the thrilling bumper tube!
